title: Yokai Daily — Guess Today's Spirit
tagline: One yokai a day. Six guesses. Six hundred years of folklore.
description: Yokai Daily is a daily word puzzle for the curious. Every day a new yokai from Japanese folklore — a kappa from the river, a tengu from the mountain, a kitsune with a thousand tails — and you have six guesses to name it in romaji. The silhouette is the only hint you get; each color-coded guess narrows it down. Solved or not, you stay for the lore: a short notebook entry on the spirit you faced today, in English or Japanese. Comes back fresh at midnight, every day.

controls.en: Type a yokai name and tap Enter. The silhouette is your only hint.
controls.ja: 妖怪の名をタイプして決定。シルエットがあなたの唯一の手がかり。
